sources.scope: YDG header/tile layout, QOI/WebP recognition, template rebuilding, CP932 font page order, glyph style and symbol positioning workflow.
Variable header length and interpretation of the tile low 16 bits as horizontal x coordinate.

changes: Pillow supplies QOI/WebP codecs; upstream GUI, native DLL and C acceleration are not copied or executed.
Reject unsupported versions, overlapping tiles, malformed QOI/RIFF, animation and oversized allocations.
Retain tile coordinates, physical ordering, header extensions, reserved fields, gaps and trailer; rebuild against immutable originals and verify decoded pixels.
Explicit font grid/style configuration replaces sample-specific sizes, paths and directory detection; missing/clipped glyphs fail instead of falling back silently.
Reuse common JIS mappings; do not duplicate subs_cn_jp.json or ship fonts.
Publish only complete new output trees, with original hashes, reparsed metadata and reports.
